author: nyx+znq19
description: A headless browser plugin that allows AI to control a browser for web browsing, screenshots, downloads, uploads, and more. It defaults to taking over the local real browser (inheriting login state), with fallback options to plugin persistent profile / system browser / auto-download built-in Chromium.

zh.description: 让 AI 能够控制浏览器进行网页浏览、截图、下载、上传等操作。默认接管本地真实浏览器（继承登录态），逐级回退到插件持久 profile / 系统浏览器 / 自动下载内置 Chromium
